title: Canon per Augmentationem in Contrario Motu

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the upper voice leads, alone.
☞ Comes: the lower voice, upside down and twice as slow.
☞ The roles change: the lower voice leads.
☞ The upper voice follows, inverted and at double length.

listenFor: canon upside down and at double length; then the parts change places
